hook.text: The median agent takes fifteen hours to answer a listing inquiry. Seventy-eight percent of buyers go with whoever answers first.

save.text: Qualified, pre-approval confirmed, showing booked, notes in the CRM — in the first four seconds of the call, not the fifteenth hour.

seller.text: Sellers too. A what's-my-home-worth call becomes a listing appointment on the agent's calendar.

cta.text: Want every listing call answered and every buyer qualified? Let's build it.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Harbor and Vine Realty, this is Sloane — are you calling about a listing?

call1.speaker: caller
call1.text: Yes, the two-bedroom on Vine Street, unit five B. Is it still available?

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: It is. Quick questions so I can set you up with Ben, the listing agent: what's your budget range, and are you pre-approved?

call1.speaker: caller
call1.text: Four-fifty to five hundred, and yes, pre-approved with Chase. We'd want to move within sixty days.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Perfect fit. Ben has Saturday at eleven open for a showing — shall I book it and text you the details?

call2.speaker: caller
call2.text: Hi, I'm thinking about selling my place in Cedar Hills next spring. What's it worth?

call2.speaker: alex
call2.text: Happy to help. Ben can do a comparative market analysis at the house — Tuesday at five-thirty works for him. Shall I put you on his calendar?
